response.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT s.entrystat,
         AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp,
         AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment AS e
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.entrystat
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(imgcount) AS avg_imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment
)
SELECT sa.entrystat,
       sa.avg_ambictemp,
       sa.avg_imgcount,
       sa.avg_imgcount - oa.avg_imgcount AS imgcount_avg_diff
FROM status_averages AS sa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa;

assumptions.assumption: The overall image-count average is across all scanenvironment records, including records whose zoneref does not match a site; AVG ignores null image counts.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate the overall average only across environment records that match a site, using the same joined population as the status averages.

  SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment AS e
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT entrystat,
         AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp,
         AVG(imgcount) AS avg_imgcount
  FROM matched_environment
  GROUP BY entrystat
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(imgcount) AS avg_imgcount
  FROM matched_environment
)
SELECT sa.entrystat,
       sa.avg_ambictemp,
       sa.avg_imgcount,
       sa.avg_imgcount - oa.avg_imgcount AS imgcount_avg_diff
FROM status_averages AS sa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa;
